notes.title: Verbal to Non-verbal
notes.content:
Convert a given paragraph into a tree diagram, flowchart, table, pie chart, etc.
- Read carefully and pick out main points.
- Do not add your own points.
- Give a suitable title.

**Marking Scheme:**
Title (1), Covering all points (2), Appropriate graphic/layout (1), Overall presentation (1).

notes.title: Non-verbal to Verbal
notes.content:
Write a paragraph based on a given chart, web, graph, etc.
- Cover all points given.
- Give a suitable title.

**Marking Scheme:**
Title (1), Use of given points (2), Grammar (1), Appropriate language and conclusion (1).

notes.title: Example Non-verbal to Verbal: Barriers to Effective Communication
notes.content:
**Barriers to Effective Communication**
Good communication is very important for the well-being of society. However, there are many barriers to effective communication. Difference in language and a lack of interest in the topic are two major ones. If the communicators cannot understand each others' language, or if they are not interested in the topic under discussion, then communication will be affected negatively. This is also the case if there is any form of discomfort with the topic being discussed. Noise in the vicinity hinders communication just as distance between the communicators does. And last but not the least, any type of distraction for the communicators will prove to be an effective barrier. One must get rid of these barriers if one wants good communication.
